steps: System software manages and controls the computer hardware and provides the environment in which application software runs.
It helps the computer start and carry out basic operations.
It manages system resources such as the processor, memory, storage, and input/output devices.
It provides an interface between the user, application programs, and computer hardware.
It helps keep the computer secure and working efficiently through utility programs.
Examples of system software include operating systems, utility software, and device drivers.
items.finalAnswer: System software manages computer hardware and resources and provides a platform for application software.

steps: An operating system manages the computer's hardware and software resources and provides an interface for the user. Examples include Microsoft Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Utility software performs maintenance and protection tasks to help keep a computer secure and efficient. Examples include antivirus software, backup utilities, and disk-cleanup tools.
A device driver enables the operating system to communicate with and control a hardware device. Examples include printer, sound, and graphics drivers.
items.finalAnswer: Operating systems manage the computer, utility software maintains it, and device drivers enable communication with hardware.

steps: System software controls or manages the computer and provides a platform for other software.
Application software is designed to help the user perform particular tasks.
System software usually works in the background, while application software is used directly to complete tasks.
Application software depends on system software to run.
Examples of system software are operating systems and device drivers; examples of application software are word processors and spreadsheets.
items.finalAnswer: System software manages the computer and supports other programs, whereas application software helps users perform specific tasks.

steps: Use a trusted utility program to check the computer and identify unnecessary files, security risks, or performance problems.
Run a disk-cleanup utility to remove temporary files and other unneeded data, checking the items before deleting them.
Uninstall programs that are no longer needed and disable unnecessary programs from starting automatically.
Use the operating system's storage or disk-management tools to check available space; defragment a hard disk drive if recommended. Do not defragment a solid-state drive.
Update the operating system, utility software, and applications so that known security problems can be fixed.
Run an up-to-date antivirus utility to scan for and remove or quarantine malware.
Back up important files regularly using a backup utility or a trusted external or online storage service.
Restart the computer and check whether it is working properly; use the utility's report or results to decide whether further action is needed.
items.finalAnswer: Use cleanup and maintenance utilities to improve performance, and antivirus, updates, and backups to maintain security.

steps: Identify the hardware device and the computer's operating system and version.
Obtain the correct driver from the hardware manufacturer's official website or a trusted operating-system update service.
Install the driver by following the installation instructions, then restart the computer if required.
Check for driver updates through the operating system's update or device-management tools, or the manufacturer's website.
If a device does not work, check its connections and power, then look for error messages in the operating system's device-management tool.
Update or reinstall the correct driver. If a recent update caused the problem, use the system's rollback option when available.
Restart the computer and test the device. Avoid drivers from unknown sources.
items.finalAnswer: Install and update the correct driver from a trusted source, then diagnose errors and reinstall or roll back the driver if needed.

steps: Word-processing applications create, edit, format, save, and print text documents. Examples include Microsoft Word and LibreOffice Writer.
Spreadsheet applications organise data in rows and columns and use formulas and functions for calculations; they can also create charts. Examples include Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice Calc.
Presentation applications create slide shows containing text, images, and other media, and can display them to an audience. Examples include Microsoft PowerPoint and LibreOffice Impress.
Graphic-design applications create or edit pictures, drawings, and other visual designs. Examples include Paint and Adobe Photoshop.
items.finalAnswer: Application software helps users create documents, calculate and analyse data, prepare presentations, and design or edit graphics.
